digest.component_or_area: deterministic clarity-criteria validation against ticket history
propositions: Proposed deterministic clarity criteria are validated adversarially against a corpus of signed, closed, accepted tickets to find historical false positives.
Requiring nonempty canonical sections like ## Approach and ## Scope is disproved as written because valid closed tickets carry plan mechanism via aliases such as ## What.
A placeholder/exact-lexicon detector flagging phrases like 'check if' produces false positives on mechanically decidable bounded conditional work, so it should be advisory only.
Per-AC explicit proof-marker coverage and AC conjunction/hedge hygiene are disproved as hard oracles because valid ACs express behavioral assertions and coherent bundled matrices without markers.
A grounded edit-set requirement of Scope plus file_impact wrongly rejects read-only analysis, operational, and external-attestation tickets with an explicit no-edit output contract.
Testing sections requiring both happy and negative scenarios falsely fail mechanical migration tickets where negative user-flow taxonomy is inapplicable.
